column4: A young man with curly dark hair in a light gray hoodie sits at a desk in a dorm room at night and talks to the phone camera in a casual selfie video. He holds a phone up beside his face with its blank white screen facing the camera, keeping the phone steady and face-on the whole time. He speaks with natural lip movement and a half smile, small head movements. String lights and framed pictures on the wall behind him. Handheld phone camera, realistic skin texture, natural motion.

A tired young man with curly dark hair in a white t-shirt stands in a small kitchen in the morning and talks to the camera in a handheld selfie video held at arm's length. He rubs the back of his neck with one hand while he speaks, looking worn out, then drops the hand and gives a small shrug. Natural lip movement, slight handheld camera shake. Daylight from the window, a fridge covered in colourful sticky notes behind him. Realistic skin texture, natural motion.

A relaxed young man with curly dark hair in a navy puffer jacket over a gray hoodie sits in the driver's seat of a parked car at sunset and talks to a phone camera resting steady on the dashboard. He speaks calmly with natural lip movement and a small easy smile, one hand gesturing lightly, and gives a casual nod near the end. Warm low sunlight on his face, a parking lot and brick buildings through the window. Steady camera, realistic skin texture, natural motion.
